explanations: **Don't worry about it.** = 别担心/没事，宽慰对方的标准说法，也可用来回应道歉（= 没关系）。
口语更短版：**No worries.**（澳洲口语最爱）/ **It's fine.** 别写成 Don't worries（worry 动词不加 s）。

items.sentence: As long as you're happy, that's all that matters.
items.translation: 只要你开心，其他都不重要。
explanations:
`As long as` = 只要（条件连词）。常见错误：
• "As **long** you're happy" → 漏第二个 as
• "So long as" → 也可，但 as long as 更口语

`that's all that matters` = 其他都不重要。`that matters` 是定语从句，修饰 all；matter 在这里作动词，表示‘重要’。常见错误：
• "that **is** matters" → matter 是动词，不加 is
• "what matters" → 可以替换，但句式不同。

sentenceAudio.text: As long as you're happy, that's all that matters.

items.sentence: Cheer up, it's not the end of the world.
items.translation: 打起精神来，又不是世界末日。
explanations:
安慰朋友。`Cheer up!` = 振作点！常见错误：
• "Cheer up you" → 祈使不加宾语
• "Cheer!" → 加油欢呼，安慰用 cheer up
`It's not the end of the world.` 固定表达 = 没那么糟。

sentenceAudio.text: Cheer up, it's not the end of the world.

items.sentence: Don't worry, everything will work out fine.
items.translation: 别担心，一切都会好起来的。
explanations:
安慰他人。`Don't worry` = 别担心。常见错误：
• "Not worry" → 祈使否定用 Don't
• "Don't worrying" → 祈使后原形

`work out` = 解决/进展顺利。常见错误：
• "work out **well**" → 也可，fine/well 皆可
• "work it out" 带宾语时放中间

sentenceAudio.text: Don't worry, everything will work out fine.

items.sentence: No matter what happens, I'll be here for you.
items.translation: 无论发生什么，我都会在你身边。
explanations:
`No matter what...` = 无论什么……（让步从句）。常见错误：
• "No matter **whatever**" → no matter what 或 whatever 二选一
• "No matter what will happen" → 从句用一般现在时 happens
`be here for you` = 陪着你/支持你。

sentenceAudio.text: No matter what happens, I'll be here for you.

items.sentence: Take your time, there's no rush.
explanations:
`Take your time` = 慢慢来/别着急。常见错误：
• "Take time" → 少了 your，语义变「花时间」
• "Take your times" → time 此处不可数
`there's no rush` = 不赶时间。同义：No hurry.

sentenceAudio.text: Take your time, there's no rush.

explanations:
`bother` 表「打扰、使烦恼」。常见错误：
• "What's brother you?" → brother 是「兄弟」，正确拼写是 bothering
• "What's bother you?" → 进行时要用 -ing
现在进行时表「此刻正在」。同义：What's wrong? / What's on your mind?

`You'll` = you will，表安慰性的预测。常见错误：
• "You'll be fine." 写成 "Your be fine" → Your 是所有格
• "You will be fine" → 不缩写也可以，语气更正式
`fine` 表「没问题、没事」。同义：You'll do great. / You'll be okay.

否定祈使句用 Don't + 动词原形。常见错误：
• "Doesn't beat" → 祈使句用 don't
• "Not beat" → 缺助动词

`beat yourself up` 是习语，表「过度自责」，与「打自己」无关。常见错误：
• "beat up yourself" → 反身代词要放中间
• "beat yourself" → 少了 up，习语不成立

`I've been there` 字面是「我去过那里」，引申为「我也经历过、我懂你」。常见错误：
• "I been there" → 少了 've
• "I've gone there" → gone 强调去了没回，表「经历过」用 been
这是安慰别人时的高频共情表达。同义：I know the feeling. / Been there.

`be here for sb` 表「陪着你、支持你」。常见错误：
• "I'm here to you" → 固定搭配用 for
• "I hear for you" → hear 是「听见」，同音但意思完全不同
同义：I've got your back. / I'm with you.

口语省略主语 I，直接以 Hope 开头。常见错误：
• "Hoping you're feeling better" → 句子不能以动名词开头当谓语
• "I hope you feeling better" → 从句里缺 are

`better` 是 well 的比较级，表「好一些」。常见错误：
• "more better" → 比较级不叠用
同义：Hope you feel better soon.

`just` 在这里缓和语气，等于「你就放松吧」。常见错误：
• "Just relax you" → 祈使句不加主语
• "Just relaxing" → 祈使句要用动词原形
安慰别人：Take it easy. / Relax, it's fine. / Just breathe.

`Don't be + 形容词` 是安慰别人时的固定否定式。常见错误：
• "Don't sad" → 形容词前必须加 be
• "No be sad" → 否定祈使用 don't
相关安慰语：Cheer up. / It's okay. / I'm here for you.

`get yourself together` = 振作起来、把状态调回来。常见错误：
• "Get together yourself" → yourself 要紧跟 get
• "Get you together" → 反身代词要用 yourself
更常用：Pull yourself together. / Get a grip.

`let me + 动词原形` 表请求允许自己做什么。常见错误：
• "Let me to hug you" → let 后不加 to
• "Let I hug you" → let 后要用宾格 me
相关：Give me a hug.（抱一下）/ Can I hug you?
